story_review.one_viewing_summary: Planned chain at code scope, not an observed film. It is unchanged by repair 9 apart from two narration pauses. At a clinic wall, anonymous scrub-sleeved hands type, and a final key strike sends the question card from the wall chart into the wall-mounted OpenEvidence tool. One answer drops out with three citation cards tucking into its Sources slot. Dated tags pin to the teal record boundary. A masked sign-in opens the record lock, and at the cut (now with a comma pause) a detail fills the question in plain-language word shapes. On a reading surface the citations fan out, and after a full-stop pause at the cut, 'Medical literature' and 'Clinical guidelines' lift. Seven of twelve faceless figures light past Half and a decision-support tag pins. Then come 'UTMB's own report' and, in a large close, the 'Accuracy' and 'Patient care' tags reading 'Not in release'. A thread links the literature card to the Sources slot while the empty Accuracy ring pulses. The evaluating tag drops onto the bar, and the film closes on the answer beside the chart.
